title: Bring who you like
text:
Cinderhold no longer requires particular classes. Any group of 5 to 20 level 20 heroes can enter.

⬆️ Cinderhold no longer requires a Tank, Healer, Support and Damage: they are recommended, not required. You still need 5 to 20 heroes, all level 20
⬆️ If your raid is missing a role, the gate tells you which one most raids bring, then lets you in anyway
